utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I think it's a great idea to help each other out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Are people actually signing up for that?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, yes! I signed up myself—they're fixing bikes and small appliances at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I heard we're doing a repair drive this weekend. Are you planning to join?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a repair drive? That sounds... familiar. I think I might've heard something about it, but I'm not sure if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. We're fixing up donated electronics and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm not sure, but I think the notice said it kicks off around 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, I'll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, a repair drive? What's that for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to collect tools and materials for fixing up homes around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds helpful. How can I contribute?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, how's the repair drive coming along? Do you know if they need any help during the after-school hours?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think they could always use extra hands! I can check with the organizers if you'd like to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That'd be great, thanks! I'm free most afternoons, so just let me know what times they need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Oren. Do we have a set schedule for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Let me think... I'm not sure, I might have forgotten to write it down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I see. Well, let's figure it out now then—I like to have things planned ahead.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We could use your help spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I'd love to help, but I'm a bit worried about the timing. Do you know what time it starts and ends?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 9 AM and runs until 4 PM on Saturday. Could you help me let others know? I think you'd be great at rallying people!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rosa, what's this repair drive you mentioned? I'm new here, so I'd love to hear more about it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, welcome! The repair drive is our community event where neighbors help each other fix broken items—furniture, appliances, clothes, you name it. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I have a wobbly chair that might be perfect for that. When is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mara, I heard you mention a repair drive. Could you tell me more about what that involves?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: A repair drive is where neighbors bring broken household items to a central spot, and volunteers help fix them for free—it reduces waste and builds community.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds wonderful. When and where will it be held?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The drive... yes, I've been meaning to ask about the timeline.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, the timeline? Honestly, I'm not too sure myself.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I see. I hope it won't take too long. I'm counting on it, actually.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mina, I heard about the repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools in my garage if you need to borrow any.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you have a socket wrench set I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure do, I've got a full set. Want me to grab it for you or come on over and pick it up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Bo, where exactly is this repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Over by the park, I think.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Which park exactly?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools I can lend out if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. That would be really helpful. I'll take good care of them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem at all. Just let me know what you need, and I'll bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: A repair drive? Is it well-organized? I hope we have enough supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we have enough supplies? I haven't seen any organization around here.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe we should take inventory first before assuming anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, are you all set for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I've got a few tools ready to go! What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I was thinking we could meet around 10 AM at the community center. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, are you here about the repair drive? I've been keeping tabs on our supplies.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey Cleo, sorry I'm late. What's the situation with the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Dane. We've got plenty of nails and lumber, but we're running low on screws and hinges.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? Lots of folks are pitching in to fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that sounds great! I've got the kids' soccer games on Saturday, but maybe I can swing by Sunday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect! Sunday's actually when we'll be doing the painting and landscaping, so you'd be right on time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, what's this repair drive about? I only caught bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's a community initiative where neighbors bring broken items and we fix them together, scheduled for this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah, sounds cool. Might drop by if I'm not swamped. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're working on the repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, could use help carrying tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, let's go grab them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're getting a group together to fix up the park benches.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, really? I hadn't heard—what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 9 AM, and we could really use your help! Everyone's chipping in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Eli, did you see the repair drive schedule for this month? I think it's in the west lot again.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh yes, I saw that. It's on the 15th, right? I like to mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, the 15th, and it's definitely in the west lot. I always double-check the map to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me more about the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I heard we're collecting old electronics to fix and donate. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, I heard you were organizing a repair drive. How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? Oh, that's something I started, right? I think it's going... somewhere. Did I tell you about it already?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No, I just heard it from someone else. Sounds like a good idea though.
